# Vendor Assets

This directory contains third-party assets for the ASAGO recommender HTML demo.

## Origin

All assets are sourced from the ASAGO examples repository (asago-examples-pr35):
- **Repository**: https://github.com/asago-ai/asago-examples
- **Branch/PR**: PR #35
- **Source directory**: `/docs/demo/assets/` and `/docs/demo/`

## Assets

- **patternfly.css** (2.3 MB)
  - Red Hat PatternFly CSS framework
  - Used for UI component styling and dark/light theme support

- **branding.css** (7 KB)
  - Custom branding styles for ASAGO demo

- **logo.svg** (7 KB)
  - ASAGO project logo

- **view-state.js** (5 KB)
  - UI state management for the demo interface
  - Handles view transitions and state persistence

## License

These assets are part of the ASAGO project. Refer to ASAGO's project licensing for usage terms.
